description:
Toughneck is a Canadian trade-built apparel brand made for oilfield workers, welders, electricians, pipefitters, heavy equipment operators, and construction crews who live the job, not just work it. We create rugged, identity-driven apparel and stickers that speak directly to blue-collar culture without corporate polish or gimmicks.


What makes us different is that we don’t design for trends — we design for trades. Our products are blunt, bold, and built around real jobsite relatability. Minimal generic “workwear lifestyle” apparel that applies to everyone. Our brand voice reflects real trade humor — unapologetic, rough around the edges, and sometimes offensive to those outside the culture. Affiliates must be comfortable promoting content that reflects raw jobsite humor, including material that may be considered crude, blunt, or politically incorrect by mainstream standards.


Affiliates earn 12% commission per order with a 30-day cookie window. There is no cap on earnings, and top performers will receive increased commission opportunities and exclusive product drops.


You can promote Toughneck using your affiliate link or a personal discount code across Instagram, TikTok, YouTube, Facebook groups, trade communities, email lists, and content platforms. We encourage authentic jobsite content, lifestyle reels, truck content, shop content, and trade humor posts that align with real-world work culture.


We ship across Canada and the United States and are expanding our product line consistently. Affiliates receive early access to launches and performance-based bonuses.
payout_period: Earnings are paid out on the 1st of each month for all commissions earned during the previous month (subject to a 30-day clearing period to account for any returns or cancellations).
